detail.title: 마그네틱 척
detail.abstract: The present invention relates to a magnetic chuck. The magnetic chuck is pressed and fixated by a collet chuck from the 360° direction in a state that a plurality of support pin parts are height-adjusted according to a shape of a chucking surface of a workpiece so as to prevent shaking of the workpiece during a cutting process even if the support pin parts are extended to a long size, thereby enhancing process precision. Particularly, the present invention mainly comprises the support pin parts (10), the collet chuck (20), a collet holder (30) and electromagnet tips (40), wherein the electromagnet tips are movably installed on upper ends of the support pin parts to output a magnetic force at constant intensity with no effect from the length of the support pin parts and to extend an effective chucking area to a wide range.
